Kidney & Bladder Health

Ailment kidney bladder urinary fluid-balance detox

Evidence: scientific

Summary

Comprehensive kidney and bladder health covering urinary tract infections, bladder dysfunction, kidney stones, and related conditions affecting fluid balance and toxin removal.

Symptoms

  • urinary urgency
  • bladder discomfort
  • kidney pain
  • frequent urination
  • urinary urgency at night
  • difficulty starting urination
  • weak urine stream
  • hematuria (blood in urine)
  • flank pain

Other Treatment Options

  • Edema, Fluid Retention
    Excess fluid accumulation in tissues causing swelling, typically in legs, ankles, or abdomen. Can be caused by heart conditions, kidney dysfunction, liver disease, or medication side effects.
  • Bladder Issues
    Bladder dysfunction including urinary retention, urgency, and discomfort, often linked to fluid imbalance and tissue salt deficiencies.
  • Urinary Tract Infection (UTI)
    Infection anywhere in the urinary tract, most commonly in women. Characterized by burning pain during urination and frequent urges.
  • Kidney Issues
    Kidney dysfunction affecting fluid balance and waste filtration, leading to fluid retention, edema, and metabolic imbalances.
  • Chronic Kidney Disease
    Progressive kidney dysfunction that can lead to kidney failure, requiring dialysis or transplantation. Often causes severe edema and electrolyte imbalances.
  • UTI (Urinary Tract Infection)
    Infection in any part of the urinary system, commonly affecting the bladder and urethra. Characterized by burning pain, urgency, and frequent urination.
  • Kidney Stones
    Hard deposits of minerals and salts that form inside the kidneys and can cause severe pain when passing through the urinary tract.
  • Urinary Retention
    Difficulty emptying the bladder completely, leading to urinary urgency and potential bladder dysfunction.
  • Diuretic Herbs & Bladder Tonics
    Collection of herbal formulas specifically designed to support bladder function and promote healthy urinary elimination.
  • Prostatitis
    Inflammation of the prostate gland, often causing pain and urinary symptoms.
  • Protocol A - Amateur or Beginner
    Basic CDS protocol for foundational wellness support and mild conditions. 1 ml CDS in 100ml water, 2-3 times daily.
  • Nettles (Urtica Dioica)
    Nutritive herb rich in vitamins and minerals; supports kidney function, reduces urinary tract inflammation, and acts as a natural antihistamine.
  • Coloidal Silver
    Colloidal silver has antimicrobial properties against a wide range of pathogens; used for infections and immune support.
  • Gotu Kola (Centella Asiatica)
    Adaptogenic herb that improves circulation, supports lymphatic drainage, and promotes wound healing; traditionally used for cognitive function.
  • Buchu (Barosma betulina)
    Buchu is a traditional Southern African remedy for urinary tract infections and bladder inflammation. The leaves contain diosphenol and other compounds with antibacterial properties against common UTI pathogens. It has a long history for painful urination and prostate support.
  • Goldenrod (Solidago virga-aurea)
    Goldenrod is a traditional diuretic and anti-inflammatory for urinary tract health. It increases urine flow and has antimicrobial properties. Used for kidney stones, UTIs, and prostate inflammation with painful urination.
